notes.title: Cardpocalypse with devs Colm Larkin & Fred Mangan
notes.content:
Game Director [b]Colm Larkin[/b] and Creative Director [b]Fred Mangan[/b] will play Cardpocalypse while providing background commentary and insights into its creation.

[list]
[*]First hour: [b]Gauntlet Mode[/b] - Colm & Fred playing the roguelike challenge mode, joined by Game Designer [b]Angelo Nikolaou[/b]

[*]Second hour: [b]Out Of Time[/b] - Colm & Fred playing the standalone narrative expansion, joined by Game Writer [b]Ellen Cunningham[/b]
[/list]
